1280	
1281	def _search_dynamic(width, height, obstacles, frames, start, goal, costs,
1282	                    trace, max_expanded, max_cost=None, snapshot=False,
1283	                    allow_wait=False, state=None, cost_frames=None,
1284	                    reservations=None, goal_not_before=None):
1285	    """History-sensitive time-expanded A*.
1286	
1287	    Frame ``t`` constrains the cell occupied at path index ``t``; frames
1288	    past the last one reuse the last frame. ``frames`` may be ``None``
1289	    when ``cost_frames`` or ``reservations`` is given: time-varying costs
1290	    or reserved routes alone already make the search space time-expanded.
1291	    With ``cost_frames`` the price of
1292	    entering a cell at time ``t`` is that frame's cell value (frames past
1293	    the last one reuse the last frame); the start cell is never counted.
1294	    With ``reservations`` (normalized reservation paths) a candidate
1295	    route may not enter a vertex another agent occupies at the same
1296	    frame, nor traverse the reverse of a reserved directed edge between
1297	    two frames; reserved vertices persist at each path's final
1298	    coordinate. Waiting in place (unless ``allow_wait`` is set) and repeated
1299	    coordinates are forbidden, so
1300	    whether a candidate route can be
1301	    extended depends on the exact sequence of cells it already visited:
1302	    two routes reaching the same ``(x, y, t)`` with different histories
1303	    are distinct states and neither may prune the other (the route with
1304	    the larger accumulated cost can be the only one that remains
1305	    extendable). Each heap node therefore carries its complete path; the
1306	    search is a best-first traversal of the feasible route tree. Goal
1307	    closings are collected until the heap's smallest f exceeds the best
1308	    goal cost, after which the minimum-cost goal tie-break is settled by
1309	    the fixed f, h, x, y, t priority and then the complete path's
1310	    lexicographic order. With ``max_cost`` a candidate route whose
1311	    accumulated entering-cell cost would exceed the limit is discarded
1312	    (``cost_limited`` records that any discard happened, so a failure can
1313	    be reported as ``cost_exhausted``; the flag is part of the snapshot
1314	    state). With ``allow_wait`` a route may also stay in its current cell
1315	    for one frame at no entering-cell cost, generated only while the next
1316	    time step still lies within the provided frames and the cell is free
1317	    there; consecutive waits repeat the coordinate in the path, and once
1318	    a cell is left it may never be re-entered. With ``goal_not_before``
1319	    (used by ``plan_agents``) a route may not enter the goal cell before
1320	    that frame, because a reserved route still occupies it at some later
1321	    frame and the goal cell stays occupied once the route ends; such
1322	    candidates are never generated, exactly like reserved vertices.
1323	    With ``snapshot=True`` a
1324	    budget stop additionally
1325	    returns a checkpoint of the complete route-tree state; ``state``
1326	    carries such a snapshot back in for ``resume``.
1327	    """
1328	
1329	    def heuristic(point):
1330	        return abs(point[0] - goal[0]) + abs(point[1] - goal[1])
1331	
1332	    last_frame = len(frames) - 1 if frames is not None else None
1333	    last_cost_frame = len(cost_frames) - 1 if cost_frames is not None else None
1334	
1335	    def step_cost(point, t):
1336	        # Cost of entering ``point`` at time ``t``; the start cell is
1337	        # never entered. Time-varying frames take the value of frame
1338	        # ``t`` (the last frame persists); otherwise the static ``costs``
1339	        # matrix or unit steps apply.
1340	        if cost_frames is not None:
1341	            frame = (cost_frames[t] if t <= last_cost_frame
1342	                     else cost_frames[last_cost_frame])
1343	            return frame[point[1]][point[0]]
1344	        if costs is None:
1345	            return 1
1346	        return costs[point[1]][point[0]]
1347	
1348	    def frame_cells(t):
1349	        if frames is None:
1350	            return frozenset()
1351	        return frames[t] if t <= last_frame else frames[last_frame]
1352	
1353	    if reservations is not None:
1354	        vertex_frames, edge_frames = _reservation_frames(reservations)
1355	        last_res_frame = len(vertex_frames) - 1
1356	    else:
1357	        vertex_frames = edge_frames = last_res_frame = None
1358	
1359	    def reserved_vertices(t):
1360	        # Cells another agent occupies at frame ``t``; the final
1361	        # coordinate of every reservation path persists.
1362	        if vertex_frames is None:
1363	            return frozenset()
1364	        return (vertex_frames[t] if t <= last_res_frame
1365	                else vertex_frames[last_res_frame])
1366	
1367	    def reserved_edges(t):
1368	        # Directed edges (a, b) another agent traverses between frames
1369	        # ``t`` and ``t + 1``; a candidate may not move from ``b`` to
1370	        # ``a`` on that transition.
1371	        if edge_frames is None:
1372	            return frozenset()
1373	        return (edge_frames[t] if t <= last_res_frame
1374	                else edge_frames[last_res_frame])
1375	
1376	    # Waits may only enter provided frames: dynamic obstacle frames and
1377	    # reservation frames each provide them.
1378	    wait_last = _wait_horizon(frames, vertex_frames)
1379	
1380	    # Heap entries are (f, h, x, y, t, g, path, seen): f/h/x/y/t give the
1381	    # fixed numeric priority and candidates still tied are ordered by the
1382	    # complete coordinate path lexicographically, so ordering never depends
1383	    # on obstacle sets, in-frame coordinate order, or traversal order. The
1384	    # frozenset ``seen`` mirrors ``path`` for an O(1) repeat check and is
1385	    # never compared (distinct histories always differ in ``path``).
1386	    if state is None:
1387	        h0 = heuristic(start)
1388	        start_path = (start,)
1389	        if reservations is not None and start in reserved_vertices(0):
1390	            # The root itself would occupy a reserved vertex at frame 0,
1391	            # so no feasible route exists.
1392	            open_heap = []
1393	        elif goal_not_before is not None and start == goal:
1394	            # The single-point route would occupy the goal cell from
1395	            # frame 0 on, but a reserved route still needs it later.
1396	            open_heap = []
1397	        else:
1398	            open_heap = [(h0, h0, start[0], start[1], 0, 0, start_path,
1399	                          frozenset(start_path))]
1400	        closed_count = 0
1401	        expanded_nodes = [] if trace or snapshot else None
1402	        cost_limited = False
1403	        # Best goal closing seen so far, keyed exactly as the tie-break
1404	        # specializes at the goal: (g, t, path) (there f == g, h == 0 and
1405	        # (x, y) is fixed). Closing a goal does not stop the search
1406	        # immediately: an equally cheap route whose chain runs through
1407	        # higher-h nodes might still be undeveloped. Since each move costs
1408	        # at least 1 and the Manhattan h changes by at most 1 per move,
1409	        # f = g + h never decreases along a route; once the smallest f on
1410	        # the heap exceeds the best goal cost, no route of that cost (or
1411	        # less) can remain undiscovered.
1412	        best_key = None
1413	    else:
1414	        open_heap = state["open"]
1415	        closed_count = state["closed_count"]
1416	        expanded_nodes = state["expanded_nodes"]
1417	        best_key = state["best_key"]
1418	        cost_limited = state["cost_limited"]
1419	    budget_stop = False
1420	    has_status = max_expanded is not None or max_cost is not None
1421	
1422	    while open_heap:
1423	        if best_key is not None and open_heap[0][0] > best_key[0]:
1424	            break
1425	        if max_expanded is not None and closed_count >= max_expanded:
1426	            # Live route candidates remain but the budget is spent; close
1427	            # nothing more. A goal already closed still wins below.
1428	            budget_stop = True
1429	            break
1430	        _, _, x, y, t, g, path, seen = heapq.heappop(open_heap)
1431	        closed_count += 1  # every popped route node closes exactly once
1432	        if expanded_nodes is not None:
1433	            # Histories reaching the same (x, y, t) each record a triple,
1434	            # in the order their route nodes are actually closed.
1435	            expanded_nodes.append((x, y, t))
1436	        if (x, y) == goal:
1437	            goal_key = (g, t, path)
1438	            if best_key is None or goal_key < best_key:
1439	                best_key = goal_key
1440	            continue  # routes end at the goal; never expanded past it
1441	        next_t = t + 1
1442	        frame = frame_cells(next_t)
1443	        reserved = reserved_vertices(next_t)
1444	        for dx, dy in _NEIGHBORS:
1445	            nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
1446	            if not (0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height):
1447	                continue
1448	            nxt = (nx, ny)
1449	            if nxt in obstacles or nxt in frame or nxt in seen:
1450	                continue  # static obstacle, timed obstacle, or revisit
1451	            if nxt in reserved:
1452	                continue  # vertex another agent occupies at frame next_t
1453	            if (goal_not_before is not None and nxt == goal
1454	                    and next_t < goal_not_before):
1455	                # A reserved route still occupies the goal cell at some
1456	                # frame at or after ``next_t``; a route ending there now
1457	                # would keep the cell forever and be violated later.
1458	                continue
1459	            if (nxt, (x, y)) in reserved_edges(t):
1460	                continue  # reverse of a reserved edge on this transition
1461	            new_g = g + step_cost(nxt, next_t)
1462	            if max_cost is not None and new_g > max_cost:
1463	                # The candidate's accumulated cost exceeds the limit:
1464	                # discard it and remember that a discard happened.
1465	                cost_limited = True
1466	                continue
1467	            new_path = path + (nxt,)
1468	            h = heuristic(nxt)
1469	            heapq.heappush(
1470	                open_heap,
1471	                (new_g + h, h, nx, ny, next_t, new_g, new_path,
1472	                 seen | {nxt}),
1473	            )
1474	        if (allow_wait and wait_last is not None and next_t <= wait_last
1475	                and (x, y) not in frame and (x, y) not in reserved):
1476	            # Waiting in place: the route stays one more frame at no
1477	            # entering-cell cost. Only generated while the next time step
1478	            # still lies within the provided frames (after the last frame
1479	            # moves reuse it but no waits are generated), and only while
1480	            # the cell itself is free at that next frame. The coordinate
1481	            # is already in ``seen``, so the repeat check is untouched.
1482	            wait_path = path + ((x, y),)
1483	            h = heuristic((x, y))
1484	            heapq.heappush(
1485	                open_heap,
1486	                (g + h, h, x, y, next_t, g, wait_path, seen),
1487	            )
1488	    if best_key is None:
1489	        result = {"path": None, "cost": None, "expanded": closed_count}
1490	        if has_status:
1491	            result["status"] = _status_for(budget_stop, cost_limited)
1492	    else:
1493	        best_g, _, best_path = best_key
1494	        result = {
1495	            "path": list(best_path),
1496	            "cost": best_g,
1497	            "expanded": closed_count,
1498	        }
1499	        if has_status:
1500	            result["status"] = "found"
